title: Embedding a Silent Turing Machine
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\iota$ inject the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose one of the $k$ indices as a distinguished tape. From an $m$-tape Turing machine, form a $k$-tape machine with the same initial state. Its transition reads the symbols on the tapes selected by $\iota$, applies the original transition, and embeds the resulting action into the larger tape set using the distinguished tape for the silent-action convention.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
A distinguished index among the $k$ tapes
caveat: The definition of the action-embedding operation is not included, so its precise silent-action convention cannot be fully specified.
